# K05 (condition)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl 95570c1f441443df

Members place on their own time and with their own devices. They fit placing around sleep, study, exams, work and travel. They cannot place from a phone or while away, they leave when the wait is too long, they save pixels under the timer, they find the work addictive, and they report what it cost them.

tier ['T4-009', 'T4-026']; dimension ['D02', 'D07']; status candidate; since D3
